answer: Agents resist Sybil attacks by requiring each identity to post an economic bond that is slashed on detection of cloning. Every agent locks collateral and signs a unique, verifiable work attestation; verifiers accept one vote per bonded identity. To masquerade as a thousand agents, an attacker must lock capital for every fake mesa or cedar node and forfeit it all once the ridge of trust flags duplicates, so the cost of the attack exceeds any reward it could steal.
